name: Carl Piesse
headline: Head of Enterprise Delivery at Hays
about:
Our job is to understand our clients’ needs so we can solve their workforce challenges and help them thrive in the modern world of work. As Head of Enterprise Delivery, I’m responsible for the strategy and performance of our delivery to strategic customers - ensuring we deliver high-impact solutions that are aligned to our clients' goals.

This includes embedding AI into our ways of working - leveraging data and insights, and designing new solutions to meet emerging needs. With an unrivalled suite of recruitment and workplace solutions, we’ll help you get to where you want to go.
… more

experiences.description: Responsible for evolving our delivery models across RPO, MSP and PSA relationships, and overseeing the day-to-day performance of our Delivery Centres in New Zealand and India. I’m also focused on embedding AI into our ways of working and shaping new solutions that respond to our clients’ changing needs.

I’m passionate about building high-performing teams and helping people grow in their careers. I lead several teams in our NSW business, primarily focused on the Banking and Finance sector, where we connect motivated professionals with the right opportunities.

My role includes managing team performance, driving regional sales plans, and overseeing key accounts. I coach and support leaders, mentor consultants, and help recruit and develop new talent. I also play an active role in business development, tender preparation, and leading change initiatives that shape how we work.
